title: Jewel Toned Mexican Pork Cochinita Pibil
description: A crowd-pleasing Mexican dish featuring slow-cooked pork, little gem lettuce, and a hint of wok-hei, all made in a wok and perfect for a dinner gathering.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large wok over medium heat.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the pork shoulder to the wok and cook until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Add the orange and lime juice, dried oregano, salt, and black pepper to the wok, stirring to combine.
Reduce heat to low and simmer, covered, for 2 hours, or until the pork is tender and easily shreds with a fork.
Shred the pork with two forks and stir to coat with the cooking juices.
Add the little gem lettuce leaves to the wok and cook, stirring frequently, until wilted, about 2 minutes.
Stir in the pickled onions and cook for an additional minute.
Serve the cochinita pibil hot, garnished with additional pickled onions and little gem lettuce leaves if desired.
